title: ReportPayload
description: Canonical JSON embedded in a signed one-page HTML report (`<script type="application/json" id="agent-receipt-report">`) by `agent-receipt report`. The Ed25519 signature is a SignatureDocument (docs/signature.schema.json) over the UTF-8 hex SHA-256 of the canonical form of this object (sorted object keys, no whitespace, array order kept). It is not a signature over the HTML bytes. The same document is embedded as id `agent-receipt-report-sig` and written beside the file as `<report>.html.sig.json` when local keys load. Missing keys omit the signature. CSS, narrative wording, file lists, commit messages, risk text, diff excerpts, and the receipt bytes are not covered. `report verify` re-hashes receipt files when they are on disk. originalFingerprint, resignedBy, and signedBy are the manifest signer's claims when the report was built from a session package. This is not a certificate authority.

kind.description: Discriminator. Peers should reject other kinds.

version.description: Payload schema version. Not the CLI version.

cliVersion.description: agent-receipt version that wrote the report.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the report was written.

subject.description: receipt for one file. session for `report --session` or a `*.session` package.

session.description: Session id from the receipt or the package, or null.

manifestSha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw session-manifest.json bytes, or null when the report is not a session package.

exposure.description: redacted is the default pipeline. host is --include-host (secrets still masked). unredacted is --no-redact.

verdict.description: FAILED wins, then UNTRUSTED, then UNSIGNED when the report itself has no signature, otherwise VERIFIED. An unsigned receipt does not by itself make a signed report UNSIGNED.

verifyCommands.description: Exact offline commands shown on the page. Basenames, not absolute paths.

id.description: Receipt link id, or the canonical sha256 when the receipt has no id.

sha256.description: Canonical verify hash of the on-disk source receipt, not the redacted display body.

parent.description: Parent r- id or sha256, or null.

verified.description: True when the receipt hash path matches.

signature.description: Receipt sidecar status. invalid is a present sidecar that does not verify.

fingerprint.description: 64-hex fingerprint of the receipt sidecar, or null when unsigned.

trusted.description: True or false when an allowlist was active and the sidecar verified. Null when unsigned, invalid, or the allowlist was inactive.

originalFingerprint.description: Manifest signer's claim of the source sidecar fingerprint, or null. Not a second signature.

resignedBy.description: Manifest signer's claim of the key that re-signed a different key, or null.

signedBy.description: Manifest signer's claim of the exporter key that signed an unsigned source whose bytes changed, or null.
